parts.name: Rider Seat
parts.description: A low solo rider seat, 27.2 in high. Seen from above it is a teardrop: a narrow nose tucks under the tank and the rear is wide and rounded (diagram #2). It is held by a rear bolt with a collar and grommet (#12, #11, #1) and sits on rubber cushions underneath (#3–#6). This is the standard model's seat; the SE gets a brown diamond-stitch seat instead.
parts.function: Rider support. The low seat height is central to the Rebel's approachability: Honda says it is meant 'to ensure riders of any height feel confident when coming to a stop.'

facts.label: SE difference
facts.value: SE uses a brown diamond-stitch seat (not this model)

oem.note: Rider seat is diagram item #2. Part number not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Fenders
parts.description: The front and rear fenders. Their shapes in the 3D view are representative of the Rebel's short, bobbed style.
parts.function: Keep road spray and debris off the rider and the bike.

parts.name: Front Fender
parts.description: A short front fender over the front tire.
parts.function: Deflects spray thrown up by the front tire.

parts.name: Rear Fender
parts.description: A bobbed rear fender carrying the taillight and turn signals.
parts.function: Shields the rider and the electrics from rear-tire spray.

parts.name: Side Covers
parts.description: Left and right side panels below the seat. Their shapes, and what they conceal, are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
parts.function: Cover and protect components under the seat area and tidy the bike's appearance.

parts.name: License Plate Bracket
parts.function: Holds the license plate under the license light.
